description.zh-CN: Jsonita 产品、计划、规格、发布与工作流的重要变化记录。
description.en: Important Jsonita product, plan, spec, release, and workflow changes.

rows.zh-CN: 旧设计探索稿中的稳定决策已迁入 plan/spec 权威文档，并删除旧设计目录以避免死链和重复权威。
rows.en: Migrated stable decisions from the old design explorations into authoritative plan/spec docs and removed the old design directory to avoid dead links and duplicate authority.
plan/00, plan/01, spec/01, spec/03, spec/06, src/styles/tokens.css, CHANGELIST.md, site/changelist.json, and changelist.html.

rows.zh-CN: 运行本地链接检查、CAST docs freshness/profile 检查，并用精准搜索确认旧设计目录引用清零。
rows.en: Run local link checks, CAST docs freshness/profile checks, and targeted search to confirm old design-directory references are cleared.

rows.zh-CN: 后续 UI 实现只看 spec/01 视觉权威、spec/03 token/动效、spec/06 窗口 runtime 与 plan/01 功能约束。
rows.en: Future UI work should use spec/01 for visual authority, spec/03 for tokens/motion, spec/06 for window runtime, and plan/01 for feature constraints.

rows.zh-CN: 按最新版 cast-a-start 修复 Jsonita 文档结构：新增 .cast-docs/WORKFLOW.md，瘦身 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md，升级首页、TODO、CHANGELIST 为 CAST JSON-first 渲染面，并补充 docs:render / docs:check / docs:render-mermaid。
rows.en: Repaired the Jsonita documentation structure against the latest cast-a-start: added .cast-docs/WORKFLOW.md, thinned AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md, upgraded homepage, TODO, and CHANGELIST to CAST JSON-first rendered surfaces, and added docs:render / docs:check / docs:render-mermaid.
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cast-docs/WORKFLOW.md, site/*.json, index.html, todo.html, changelist.html, scripts/*docs*.mjs, package.json, and plan/spec legacy diagram surfaces.

rows.zh-CN: 运行 CAST profile 校验、CAST JSON 渲染与 freshness 检查、本地链接检查、Mermaid/raw CDN 发布面检查和 git diff 空白检查。
rows.en: Run CAST profile validation, CAST JSON rendering and freshness checks, local link checks, Mermaid/raw CDN published-surface checks, and git diff whitespace checks.

rows.zh-CN: plan/spec 全量 JSON-first 迁移仍作为 TODO P1 逐页推进，不在本次结构修复中伪装为已完成。
rows.en: Full plan/spec JSON-first migration remains TODO P1 and should proceed page by page; this structure repair does not pretend it is already done.

rows.zh-CN: 用 cast-a-doc 重新生成双语文档首页。
rows.en: Regenerated the bilingual documentation homepage with cast-a-doc.

rows.zh-CN: 继续让首页源与渲染产物保持 freshness。
rows.en: Keep homepage source and rendered output fresh.

rows.zh-CN: README 与文档首页声明 CAST 写作约定。
rows.en: Declared the CAST writing contract in README and the documentation homepage.

rows.zh-CN: 需求、规格或实现变更继续同步 README、index、site JSON、plan 与 spec。
rows.en: Requirement, spec, or implementation changes should continue to sync README, index, site JSON, plan, and spec.

rows.zh-CN: 设计稿核心决策迁入 plan/spec，并补齐 CAST 文档源数据层。
rows.en: Migrated stable design decisions into plan/spec and added the CAST source-data layer.
plan/, spec/, site/todo.json, site/changelist.json, todo.html, changelist.html, and index.html.

rows.zh-CN: 旧探索稿只作为历史事件记录；稳定结论已经迁入 plan/spec，后续实现不再依赖探索稿。
rows.en: Old exploration drafts remain only as historical events; stable conclusions have moved into plan/spec, and future implementation no longer depends on the drafts.
